description: Alpha Factory factor(df) input contract — schema changes require separate work order.

ts.meaning: bar open time, unix epoch seconds (UTC storage)

index.note: index 任意; worker 按 symbol ASC, ts ASC 排序后传入 factor(df)

timezone: UTC (ts int); display ET optional upstream
missing_values: worker 不填充; NaN/缺失原样传入, factor 自行处理

universe.delivery: df 仅含 watchlist 内 symbol 行 (最多 8 只, ≤8000 bars)

factor_interface.return: Series aligned with df (len equal); index 与 df.index 对齐或 positional

template_comment: # Columns (whitelist): ts, symbol, o, h, l, c, v
# Index: arbitrary RangeIndex; sorted symbol+ts by worker
# Universe: symbols present in df (from worker watchlist)
